model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different models. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)," has a linear scale with values ranging from 20 to 28, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage," also has a linear scale with values ranging from 0.4 to 0.8, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The plot features four lines, each representing a different model: Llama-3B (blue, circle markers, solid line), Llama-3B + FT (green, triangle markers, solid line), Llama-1B + FT (light blue, square markers, dashed line), and Llama-1B (light green, diamond markers, dashed line). Starting at the left side of the plot, the Llama-3B line begins at approximately (20, 0.45) and increases steadily to around (28, 0.55). The Llama-3B + FT line starts at about (20, 0.45) and rises to roughly (28, 0.65). The Llama-1B + FT line begins at approximately (20, 0.35) and increases to around (28, 0.65). The Llama-1B line starts at about (20, 0.35) and rises to roughly (28, 0.55).
